name: PLOS ONE research article
capBasis: Project editorial budgets (not publisher-wide limits). PLOS abstract cap of 300 is publisher policy. Short format total includes all main text except references and title page. Separate main-display budget counts titles, captions and table cells; individual caption limits apply to main and supplementary displays. These are project editorial budgets.

policies.rule: Double spacing; continuous line numbers; abstract at most 300 words; Vancouver references.

policies.quote: the validation of findings in, at minimum, a second independent dataset
policies.rule: MR requires replicated status, second independent dataset and software literature-search sentence.

policies.quote: AI tools cannot be listed as authors.
policies.rule: Disclose all AI research/content uses and validation; interpretation represents owner ideas; AI review is internal, never peer review.

feeNote: PLOS publication charge may apply; check current fee and assistance at https://plos.org/publish/fees/ before owner submission.
